entries.name: Google Assistant TV
entries.why: Google Voice Assistant on TV. Keep if you use the microphone button on your remote for voice commands.

entries.name: Chromecast Built-in
entries.why: Google Cast receiver. Keep if you cast videos, Spotify, or YouTube from your phone/tablet to the TV.

entries.name: Miracast / Screen Mirroring
entries.why: Wireless display receiver. Keep if you cast your phone or laptop screen directly to this TV.

entries.name: MiTV Wireless Display
entries.why: Miracast receiver service. Keep if you mirror device screens wirelessly.

entries.name: TCL Miracast Screen Share
entries.why: Screen mirroring receiver for TCL TVs. Keep if you cast phone screen wirelessly.

entries.name: Google Speech & Text-To-Speech
entries.why: Accessibility screen reader and text-to-speech engine. Safe to remove if accessibility narration is unused.

entries.name: Google TV Recommendations
entries.why: Pushes sponsored rows and video previews to the home screen. Disabling stops TV promo feeds.

entries.name: Google Android TV Launcher
entries.why: Stock launcher with ads and sponsored banners. Safe to disable when using LeanTV as default home.

entries.name: Google TV / Play Movies
entries.why: Store app for renting films with heavy background trailers. Streaming apps already cover this.

entries.name: Google Play Games
entries.why: Mobile games hub that runs background sync services. Not needed for normal TV viewing.

entries.name: Google Feedback
entries.why: Constantly logs and uploads diagnostic and crash data to Google servers.

entries.name: Google TV Bug Report Sender
entries.why: Background daemon collecting bug logs and uploading system diagnostics.

entries.name: YouTube Music TV
entries.why: Preinstalled music player. Safe to remove if you don't listen to music through YouTube on TV.

entries.name: YouTube TV Stub
entries.why: Preinstalled stub for paid US cable streaming subscription.

entries.name: Google Partner Setup
entries.why: Helper for silently configuring OEM partner bloat. Not used after initial TV setup.

entries.name: One-time Initializer
entries.why: Setup helper that finished its job on first boot. Safe to turn off.

entries.name: Google Contacts Sync
entries.why: Syncs phone contacts in the background. Completely useless on a television.

entries.name: Google Calendar Sync
entries.why: Syncs calendar events in the background on TV.

entries.name: Setup Wraith
entries.why: First-time setup wizard wrapper. Consumes RAM after device is configured.

entries.name: Xiaomi PatchWall Home
entries.why: Xiaomi's ad-heavy PatchWall launcher. Disabling stops banner ads and speeds up remote response.

entries.name: Xiaomi PatchWall Core
entries.why: PatchWall service pushing curated movie teasers and sponsored promotions.

entries.name: Xiaomi TV Ad Service
entries.why: Xiaomi advertising service that loads boot ads, banner ads, and popup promotions.

entries.name: Xiaomi Telemetry & Statistics
entries.why: Collects viewing history, remote keypresses, and system telemetry.

entries.name: Xiaomi Device Analytics
entries.why: Monitors device usage and hardware health metrics sent to Xiaomi servers.

entries.name: MIUI Analytics
entries.why: System tracking and ad measurement telemetry engine.

entries.name: Mi TV Store
entries.why: Xiaomi TV online store pushing hardware accessories and digital products.

entries.name: Mi TV Payment Service
entries.why: Xiaomi payment gateway for PatchWall content purchases.

entries.name: Mi TV System Updater
entries.why: Xiaomi background OTA updater. Note: keep enabled if you wish to receive future OEM system updates.

entries.name: Mi TV App Auto-Upgrade
entries.why: Forces automatic background updates of preinstalled Xiaomi bloatware.

entries.name: Xiaomi Game Center Service
entries.why: Runs background advertising notifications for Xiaomi casual games.

entries.name: Mi TV Gallery
entries.why: Xiaomi photo gallery viewer with cloud sync reminders.

entries.name: Mi Video Player
entries.why: Default Mi video player bundled with PatchWall recommendations.

entries.name: Xiaomi TV Player
entries.why: Xiaomi linear channel streamer and promo video provider.

entries.name: Xiaomi Audio Player
entries.why: Mi Music player background service.

entries.name: Mi TV Screensaver
entries.why: PatchWall commercial screensaver displaying sponsored promotional posters.

entries.name: Mi Soundbar Companion
entries.why: Pairing helper for Xiaomi brand soundbars. Safe to remove if using TV speakers or HDMI ARC.

entries.name: Xiaomi Voice Control
entries.why: Xiaomi proprietary voice assistant running alongside Google Assistant.

entries.name: Mi Router Companion
entries.why: Background utility for Xiaomi smart Wi-Fi routers.

entries.name: Mi Home TV
entries.why: Smart home dashboard for Xiaomi IoT devices.

entries.name: Mi Remote Controller Companion
entries.why: Companion daemon for Xiaomi phone infrared remote apps.

entries.name: Mi Karaoke Service
entries.why: Microphone audio processing service for Xiaomi karaoke accessories.

entries.name: TCL Waterfall Ad Stream
entries.why: TCL home page content aggregator and banner advertising stream.

entries.name: TCL Commercial Demo
entries.why: Retail store demo mode and commercial marketing overlays.

entries.name: TCL User Agreement Tracking
entries.why: Collects telemetry regarding user agreement compliance and app telemetry.

entries.name: TCL Message Box
entries.why: Push notification server displaying manufacturer banners and promos on the TV screen.

entries.name: TCL TV Manager
entries.why: TCL optimizer bloatware running background memory cleanup prompts.

entries.name: TCL Browser
entries.why: Slow preinstalled web browser with default sponsored search engine.

entries.name: TCL Channel
entries.why: Free ad-supported streaming TV channels integrated with manufacturer ads.

entries.name: Sony Network Recommendations
entries.why: Sony Bravia network recommendation and sponsored content service.

entries.name: Sony B2B Commercial Core
entries.why: Sony commercial hotel/hospitality telemetry service.

entries.name: Sony Interactive TV Provider
entries.why: Interactive broadcast data service.

entries.name: Sony Retail Demo Mode
entries.why: Store showroom demonstration looping videos.

entries.name: Hisense HiCloud Account
entries.why: Hisense cloud telemetry and profile analytics tracker.

entries.name: Hisense TV Service
entries.why: Background manufacturer services for Hisense smart TVs.

entries.name: OnePlus TV Experience Program
entries.why: Collects remote control usage patterns and analytics.

entries.name: Realme TV Telemetry
entries.why: Realme smart TV device diagnostics and telemetry push service.

entries.name: Amazon System Marketplace
entries.why: Amazon sponsored ad service and background marketplace analytics.

entries.name: Prime Video
entries.why: Remove if you do not use Amazon Prime Video. Note: Prime remote button won't launch app.

entries.name: Netflix
entries.why: Remove if you do not use Netflix. Note: Netflix remote button won't launch app.

entries.name: JioCinema
entries.why: Preinstalled Indian streaming app. Safe to remove if unused.

entries.name: Disney+ Hotstar TV
entries.why: Preinstalled Hotstar streaming app. Safe to remove if unused.

entries.name: Sony LIV
entries.why: Preinstalled Sony LIV streaming app. Safe to remove if unused.

entries.name: ZEE5 TV
entries.why: Preinstalled ZEE5 streaming app. Safe to remove if unused.

entries.name: Voot TV
entries.why: Preinstalled Voot app. Safe to remove if unused.

entries.name: ALTBalaji
entries.why: Preinstalled sponsored media app. Safe to remove if unused.

entries.name: Hungama Play
entries.why: Preinstalled sponsored media app. Safe to remove if unused.

entries.name: Eros Now
entries.why: Preinstalled sponsored media app. Safe to remove if unused.

entries.name: SPOTV NOW
entries.why: Preinstalled sponsored sports app. Safe to remove if unused.
